divergences.old: saucelabs session appium <session-id> reading the Appium server URL with no write gate, and --start starting one
divergences.toil: Both need writes: true on the connection and --allow-write on the call, because one command both reads and starts a server; without them it fails with WRITE_DISABLED before any request
divergences.why: A command that can change something outside the machine goes through the write gate, and a command is a read or a write as a whole, not per flag.

divergences.old: saucelabs session create --wait waiting as long as --timeout says
divergences.toil: The same wait, inside a command time limit of one hour (TOIL_TIMEOUT_MS overrides it); a --timeout past that ends in TIMEOUT from the limit instead of the wait's own message
divergences.why: Every command has a time limit and can be cancelled (Output Contract). An hour covers the default --timeout 300 many times over.
